title: Connection protocol record
description: One record of component's connection protocol registry, specifications/component/v2/protocols/<protocol>.json: the members a protocol fixes, with their roles, presence, defaults, sensitivity and value constraints. $defs/ProtocolCategories is the shape of the registry's categories.json. The registry is normative for the facts it tabulates; component v2 §6.4 is normative for what they mean (docs/adr/0045).
$comment: docs/adr/0045. A role says what a member is for, and presence whether every connection holds it. A derived member has the derived role and presence, and only it. A credential or secret member is sensitive. A default belongs only to an optional member.

id.description: The value a connection input's protocol takes. The record's file name is this value in lower case, with each underscore a hyphen.

category.description: The category whose conventions the protocol follows. Categories are registry metadata, never a document field.

description.description: The wire contract the protocol names, in one sentence.

status.description: stable, or deprecated: still accepted, and never removed inside the major version.

introduced.description: The component release that first defined the protocol.

references.description: The vendor documents that define the wire contract. Informative.

capabilities.description: The capabilities a connection input of this protocol may require. Empty: the input takes no capabilities.

members.description: The members, in the order component §6.4 lists them.

name.description: The member name an output's from.member names.

role.description: credential: the one secret a selection's credential value supplies. secret: another secret the same credential carries, in credential.secrets. locator: the HTTPS URL a client sends requests to, which makes the protocol HTTP-based. parameter: any other member a view carries. derived: a member resolution composes from the others.

presence.description: required: every connection holds it, non-empty. optional: it may be absent, and takes its default when it has one. derived: resolution composes it.

default.description: The value an optional member takes when a connection does not hold it.

sensitive.description: Whether the member's value is sensitive, so that an output forwarding it declares sensitive: true.

schema.description: JSON Schema fragment holding the member's logical type and the value constraints component §6.4 states for it. Its type is the logical type an output forwarding the member must fit.

url.description: HTTPS URL of the referenced document.

ProtocolCategories.description: The registry's categories.json: every category, in the order component §6.4 lists them.

description.description: What the protocols of the category reach.

conventions.description: The member name each protocol of the category gives the member of a role, when it has one.

protocols.description: The category's protocols, in the order the specification lists them. Each has a record naming this category.

CategoryId.description: A protocol category. A new category needs a decision record (docs/adr/0045).
